Fonts used by the Context tool's font menu (loaded only when chosen, never uploaded):

- Roboto — Apache License 2.0 — https://github.com/googlefonts/roboto
- Open Sans — SIL Open Font License 1.1 — https://github.com/googlefonts/opensans
- Comic Neue — SIL Open Font License 1.1 — https://github.com/crozynski/comicneue
- Anton — SIL Open Font License 1.1 — https://github.com/googlefonts/AntonFont
- Caveat — SIL Open Font License 1.1 — https://github.com/googlefonts/caveat
- Playfair Display — SIL Open Font License 1.1 — https://github.com/clauseggers/Playfair

TTF files from the @expo-google-fonts npm packages (Google Fonts static builds).
Arial, Times and Courier in the menu use the PDF standard fonts (Helvetica, Times, Courier).
vendor/fontkit.umd.min.js is @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 (MIT) — lets pdf-lib embed these fonts.
